nodes.label: Apple Wallet .pkpass
nodes.rationale: iPhone only accepts passes signed with the restaurant Pass Type ID certificate; signed via openssl; NFC payload needs APPLE_NFC_PUBLIC_KEY.

nodes.label: Google Wallet pass (Smart Tap)
nodes.rationale: Classes per tier, objects per customer, save links via service-account JWT (RS256); GOOGLE_SMART_TAP enables enableSmartTap.

nodes.label: Fidelity Loyalty Programme Rules
nodes.rationale: 1 point per EUR paid times tier bonus, rounded down; amounts stored as integer cents so totals are exact; each receipt stores tier and points applied at recording time.

nodes.label: Germoglio tier (the sprout)
nodes.rationale: New customers, from first visit, x1 points; bottle green and cream with sprouts over furrows. Tier names follow the life of a field, matching Contadino (farmer).

nodes.label: Raccolto tier (the harvest)
nodes.rationale: Regular customers from EUR 250 spent, x1.25; roasted chestnut with wheat sheaf.

nodes.label: Riserva tier (the reserve)
nodes.rationale: VIP from EUR 600 spent, x1.5; black with gold foil border, guilloche rosette and crest.

nodes.label: Contactless NFC Wallet Card
nodes.rationale: Cards carry no QR/barcode; the customer taps the phone at the reader like paying and the card number is sent over NFC (Apple VAS / Google Smart Tap).

nodes.label: Contadino Club PWA (mobile/index.html)
nodes.rationale: Installable PWA with manifest and apple-touch-icon; customer side in Italian, staff side in English, Cliente/Staff switch on one device for demo.

nodes.label: localStorage sample data (deterministic demo)
nodes.rationale: Restaurant page unreachable while built, so menu/customers are deterministic sample data stored in localStorage; production needs a shared backend (Firebase/Supabase) and Web Push.

nodes.label: Reduced-motion accessibility
nodes.rationale: Motion disabled for users with prefers-reduced-motion.
